faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XK8 use?
faqLeft.a: The Jaguar XK8 uses a 4.0-litre V8 from the AJ-V8 family. From 1996 to 1999, it used the AJ26. From 1999 to 2006, it used the AJ27 — an evolution of the earlier unit.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XK8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XK8?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ26 or the AJ27 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ26 XK8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guides as standard on every AJ26 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ27 XK8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The AJ27 shares the same known pattern around timing chain tensioner wear, and we service it to the same standard as the AJ26.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XK8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XK8 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XK8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XK8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
